actions.text: Pressing "Install Latest" runs the application update command; if the latest version is a higher major version, a confirmation modal opens first.
Confirming "Install" in the major version modal closes it and runs the application update command with installMajorUpdate set to true.
Cancelling the major version modal closes it without installing.
The page loads the updates list from /update and the update settings from /settings/update.

rules.text: The "Install Latest" button shows only when some update is both installable and latest, and the update mechanism is 'builtIn' or 'script'.

For other update mechanisms with an update to install, a warning icon and a message explain that updates must be done externally. The message is the system's package update mechanism message, or a text for external, apt or docker, defaulting to external.
The update mechanism defaults to 'builtIn' when update settings are unavailable.
An update is a major update when the major version number of the first (latest) listed update is greater than that of the current version.
The install button spins while an application update command is queued or started.
The same command is not re-sent if run again within 5 seconds.
Dates display empty when no date is given.

shows.text: The page is titled "Updates" with the heading scope "System".
A loading indicator shows until both the updates list and the update settings have been fetched, unless an error occurred.
When there are no updates, an info alert shows "NoUpdatesAreAvailable" text.
Each update shows its version, its release date in the short date format (with the long date and time as a tooltip), and a branch label when the branch is not 'main'.

The update matching the current version gets a "Currently Installed" label; other updates with an installed-on date get a "Previously Installed" label. Both labels have the install date and time as a tooltip.
If an update has changes, its "New" and "Fixed" change lists are shown, each rendered as markdown list items and hidden when empty. Otherwise "MaintenanceRelease" text is shown.
When updates exist but none is both installable and latest, an up-to-date check icon with the "OnLatestVersion" message is shown.
When fetching updates or settings, a small loading indicator appears beside the install or up-to-date message.
If fetching updates fails, a warning alert "FailedToFetchUpdates" is shown. If fetching settings fails, a danger alert "FailedToFetchSettings" is shown.

sideEffects.text: Installing sends a POST to /command with the application update command and adds the returned command to the cached command list.
